# Labels

The Labels workflow (`.github/workflows/labels.yml`) creates or updates these on every push to main that edits this file.

| Name | Colour | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hypothesis` | `#5319E7` | A pre-registered, falsifiable trading hypothesis |
| `strategy` | `#1D76DB` | New strategy or pattern for the library |
| `bug` | `#D73A4A` | Something is broken or wrong |
| `data-source` | `#0E8A16` | Add or fix a data source |
| `infra` | `#BFD4F2` | CI, bootstrap, packaging, wiki sync, environment |
| `research` | `#C5DEF5` | Exploratory work that is not yet a hypothesis |
| `status:pre-registered` | `#FBCA04` | Claim and pass bars fixed, no results yet |
| `status:testing` | `#F9D0C4` | Backtest and validation running on the hypo branch |
| `status:paper` | `#FEF2C0` | Passed; running in a paper book |
| `verdict:pass` | `#0E8A16` | Met every pre-set bar |
| `verdict:fail` | `#B60205` | Missed at least one pre-set bar |
| `desk:technicals` | `#006B75` | Technicals desk |
| `desk:options` | `#006B75` | Options desk |
| `desk:earnings` | `#006B75` | Earnings desk |
